# Epilogue for CR-001 Retail PD Scorecard

# Prepare the frame with raw inputs and outcome
frame <- dat
frame$.row <- seq_len(nrow(frame))

# Export frame.csv
write.csv(frame, file.path("/work/out/frame.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# Prepare scores data
scores <- data.frame(.row = seq_len(nrow(sc)), score = pd, decision = decision)

# Ensure scores have matching .row values with frame
scores$.row <- seq_len(nrow(frame))

# Export scores.csv
write.csv(scores, file.path("/work/out/scores.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# Export coefficients if the model is parametric
if (exists("fit")) {
  coef_data <- data.frame(term = names(cf), estimate = unname(cf))
  write.csv(coef_data, file.path("/work/out/coef.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
}

# Export train_rows.csv if fitted on a subset of the frame rows
if (nrow(frame) != nrow(dat)) {
  train_rows <- which(frame$id %in% dat$id)
  write.csv(data.frame(.row = train_rows), file.path("/work/out/train_rows.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
}
data.explanation: The frame.csv is created from the 'dat' data frame, which contains the raw inputs and the outcome. The scores.csv is generated from the 'sc' data frame, ensuring that the .row values match the frame. The coefficients are exported if the model is parametric, and train_rows.csv is created only if the model was fitted on a subset of the frame rows.
